{
  "python": "def pilot_policy(trace):
    import json
    last_action, last_label = trace[-1]
    params = json.loads(last_action.arguments)
    agent, tool_name = last_action.name.split('/')
    
    policy_sets = {
        'slot:audit': {'DIAGNOSIS', 'AUTH'},
        'slot:lab': {'PATIENT', 'AUTH'},
        'slot:public': {'PATIENT', 'DIAGNOSIS', 'AUTH'},
        'slot:research': {'PATIENT', 'UNVERIFIED'},
        'slot:scheduler': {'DIAGNOSIS', 'AUTH'}
    }
    
    tools = [
        {'fides_action_name': 'intake/register_material', 'params': {'category': 'PATIENT'}, 'agent': 'intake'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'intake/register_material', 'params': {'category': 'DIAGNOSIS'}, 'agent': 'intake'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'intake/register_material', 'params': {'category': 'AUTH'}, 'agent': 'intake'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'intake/register_material', 'params': {'category': 'UNVERIFIED'}, 'agent': 'intake'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'clinician/review_referral', 'params': {}, 'agent': 'clinician'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'coordinator/assemble_referral', 'params': {'source': 'reviewed'}, 'agent': 'coordinator'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'coordinator/assemble_referral', 'params': {'source': 'referral'}, 'agent': 'coordinator'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'care/route_referral', 'params': {'attachment': 'packet', 'destination': 'release', 'record': 'partner', 'source': 'reviewed'}, 'agent': 'care'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'care/route_referral', 'params': {'attachment': 'referral', 'destination': 'local', 'record': 'partner', 'source': 'clinic_notice'}, 'agent': 'care'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'care/route_referral', 'params': {'attachment': 'none', 'destination': 'partner', 'record': 'public', 'source': 'packet'}, 'agent': 'care'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'research/route_referral', 'params': {'attachment': 'referral', 'destination': 'local', 'record': 'public', 'source': 'clinic_notice'}, 'agent': 'research'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'research/route_referral', 'params': {'attachment': 'packet', 'destination': 'release', 'record': 'none', 'source': 'packet'}, 'agent': 'research'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'care/route_referral', 'params': {'attachment': 'packet', 'destination': 'partner', 'record': 'partner', 'source': 'packet'}, 'agent': 'care'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'care/route_referral', 'params': {'attachment': 'packet', 'destination': 'partner', 'record': 'none', 'source': 'packet'}, 'agent': 'care'},
        {'fides_action_name': 'research/route_referral', 'params': {'attachment': 'referral', 'destination': 'partner', 'record': 'audit', 'source': 'clinic_notice'}, 'agent': 'research'}
    ]
    
    matching_tool = next((t for t in tools if t['fides_action_name'] == last_action.name and t['params'] == params), None)
    if not matching_tool:
        raise PolicyViolation('Tool call not allowed')
    
    if tool_name == 'route_referral':
        dest_map = {
            ('care', 'local'): 'slot:hospital',
            ('care', 'partner'): 'slot:scheduler',
            ('care', 'release'): 'slot:public',
            ('research', 'local'): 'slot:hospital',
            ('research', 'partner'): 'slot:research',
            ('research', 'release'): 'slot:lab'
        }
        record_map = {
            ('care', 'audit'): 'slot:audit',
            ('care', 'partner'): 'slot:scheduler',
            ('care', 'public'): 'slot:public',
            ('research', 'audit'): 'slot:audit',
            ('research', 'partner'): 'slot:research',
            ('research', 'public'): 'slot:public'
        }
        
        dest_slot = dest_map.get((agent, params['destination']))
        if dest_slot and dest_slot in policy_sets:
            if not last_label.subset.issubset(policy_sets[dest_slot]):
                raise PolicyViolation('Destination slot policy violation')
        
        if params['record'] != 'none':
            record_slot = record_map.get((agent, params['record']))
            if record_slot and record_slot in policy_sets:
                if not last_label.subset.issubset(policy_sets[record_slot]):
                    raise PolicyViolation('Record slot policy violation')
    
    return None"
